title: OpenAI AI Smart Speaker Exposed: Doughnut Shape, Estimated Price of $300 to $400

content_html:
According to Bloomberg, the first AI hardware device being developed by OpenAI is expected to be priced between $300 and $400. The device was previously revealed as a screenless smart speaker driven by artificial intelligence, seen as the "physical embodiment" of ChatGPT extending into real-life scenarios, and more product details are gradually being disclosed.

The report states that the device features a ring-shaped design similar to a "donut," making it easy for users to move it around different spaces in their homes, such as bedside tables or kitchen countertops. According to sources, the product will be made with high-quality metal materials, positioned as a premium consumer electronics product, and will include unique "moving parts," whose specific functions have not been disclosed yet.

In terms of price, the device is expected to be higher than the traditional smart speaker market. Its price may reach $300 to $400. Currently, most smart speakers under Amazon's brand are priced between $40 and $240. A higher pricing may become one of the challenges OpenAI faces when entering the smart speaker market.

OpenAI's move into hardware is seen as an important attempt to further expand the application boundaries of ChatGPT. Through dedicated devices, OpenAI hopes to make its AI assistant more integrated into users' daily lives. However, the smart speaker market has long faced profit pressures, and companies like Amazon previously invested significant resources in related businesses without establishing a stable profit model. Therefore, the product's future market performance remains uncertain.

According to the report, the device was jointly developed by OpenAI and LoveFrom, a design studio founded by Jony Ive, former chief design officer at Apple. It is expected to be released at some point in 2027.

Notably, OpenAI's entry into the hardware field has not been smooth. Previously, Apple sued OpenAI, accusing it of stealing trade secrets, which OpenAI denied. As AI companies gradually shift from model competition to integrated software and hardware layouts, AI terminal devices may become an important direction of industry competition in the next stage.

content_html_zh:
据彭博社报道，OpenAI 正在开发的首款 AI 硬件设备预计售价在 300 至 400 美元之间。 该设备此前被曝光为一款人工智能驱动的无屏智能音箱，被视为ChatGPT延伸到现实生活场景的“物理体现”，更多产品细节正在逐步披露。

报告称，该设备采用类似于“甜甜圈”的环形设计，使用户可以轻松地将其移动到家中的不同空间，例如床头柜或厨房台面。 据消息人士透露，该产品将采用优质金属材料制成，定位高端消费电子产品，并包含独特的“活动部件”，具体功能尚未透露。

在价格方面，该设备预计将高于传统智能音箱市场。 其价格可能达到300至400美元。 目前，亚马逊品牌下的大多数智能音箱售价在 40 美元至 240 美元之间。 更高的定价可能成为OpenAI进军智能音箱市场面临的挑战之一。

OpenAI进军硬件被视为进一步拓展ChatGPT应用边界的重要尝试。 OpenAI希望通过专用设备，让其AI助手更加融入用户的日常生活。 然而，智能音箱市场长期面临盈利压力，亚马逊等公司此前在相关业务上投入了大量资源，但没有建立稳定的盈利模式。 因此，该产品未来的市场表现仍存在不确定性。

报道称，该设备由 OpenAI 和 Apple 前首席设计官 Jony Ive 创立的设计工作室 LoveFrom 联合开发。 预计将于 2027 年某个时间发布。

值得注意的是，OpenAI进军硬件领域并不顺利。 此前，苹果起诉 OpenAI，指控其窃取商业机密，OpenAI 予以否认。 随着AI企业逐渐从模式竞争转向软硬件一体化布局，AI终端设备或将成为下一阶段行业竞争的重要方向。
